notes: weight.bin, tokenizer.json and vocab.txt are byte-reproducible: two conversions on 2026-09-28 gave identical files.

model.mlmodel is not byte-reproducible. Its protobuf maps serialise in a different order on each run, while the message itself is identical. spec_canonical_sha256 is the sha256 of the spec re-serialised with deterministic=True, which is stable.
Manifest.json is not pinned: coremltools writes fresh random identifiers into it on every conversion.
mlpackage_digest is the sha256 of the text 'weight.bin <sha256>\nspec <canonical sha256>\n'. It stands in for a hash of the whole package, which cannot be stable for the two reasons above.

EmbeddingBench's coreml_sha256 hashes every byte in the package, Manifest.json included, so the value recorded in Benchmarks/2026-07-24-bge-small-en-v1.5.json cannot be reproduced by any later conversion. Its tokenizer_sha256 matches the one pinned here.
revision is what 'main' resolved to on 2026-09-28; Hugging Face reports it last modified on 2024-02-22.
